## Activity

During March 2020, Central Eye Clinic recorded 135 captures. This represents the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The capture total is reported as provided, with no adjustment or reconciliation applied in this summary.

## Image quality

Of the 135 captures, 1 was marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.7. This result identifies the number of captures that could not proceed through grading because the image quality was insufficient. The rate is presented alongside the count to support review of overall image quality at Central Eye Clinic during March 2020.

## Grading

Grading identified 22 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag was 1, measured from photograph to grade. Together, the referable total and median lag describe the grading outcome and the typical interval associated with processing the captures. The figures provide a concise record of activity, image quality, and grading performance for Central Eye Clinic in March 2020.
